asr.full_text: This is Shah, and Doge is now sitting at one of the most sensitive areas on the chart where the next move can define the short-term direction. Current price is around $0.092. And if you remember our last update, the map was already clear. We had a downtrend line acting like a ceiling, rejecting every attempt of price to move higher. And below we marked the demand zone around 0.090,the place where buyers were expected to show up. What did the market do? Exactly that. Price rolled over from the trendline, moved down into the demand, and instead of giving a quick bounce it pushed a little deeper inside the zone. That deeper tap is important because it usually cleans weak hands and grabs liquidity before any meaningful reaction. I think the last thing to reflect on is we have two downtrend line remains unbroken. As long as we trade below it, sellers technically still control the structure, so bulls still have work to do, they must push price upward, break the trend line, and show acceptance above it. If that happens, the first destination becomes very obvious, the resistance near 0.10. That level is the same place from where the last big rejection started and where this entire leg down was created. When price revisits such an origin reactions are normal, expect volatility. They're expect fights between buyers and sellers, and then the chart will again tell us. What it wants to do next. Until that breakout happens, patience is key. Because if DOGE fails to gain strength & slips back below the demand at 0.090, then the door opens for another letdown. In that scenario, the next major area waiting below is around 0.080. You have to respect both possibilities. Trading is not about marrying one bias. It is about recognizing where invalidation happens and letting confirmation guide you. Right now, we are at support but under resistance, which means we are in the middle of decision territory. Let the market pick the side first. If we see strength and a clean break of the trend line, momentum can shift quickly. If not, weakness can drag it lower just as fast. Stay sharp and let structure lead.
